stories.title: Renewable Energy India Expo 2026: Three key takeaways
stories.description: India’s largest renewable energy trade show returned to Greater Noida, outside of Delhi, this week.

stories.title: Italy deploys 4.83 GW of PV in January-September
stories.description: Italy connected 4.83 GW of new solar capacity in the first nine months of 2026, bringing cumulative installed capacity to 48.35 GW at the end of September. Utility-scale projects accounted for 46% of new additions, while the country's cumulative battery storage capacity approached 20 GWh, according to new statistics from Italia Solare.

stories.title: Comcast loses more customers, claims other ISPs' cheap prices are "irrational"
stories.description: Comcast plans job cuts and more AI agents for its shrinking cable customer base.

stories.title: The Foundations of Scalable AI
stories.description: A scalable AI system requires a strong foundation. Data, engineering, platforms, operating models, and governance must converge to work as one.

stories.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
stories.description: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

stories.title: Agent cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation backed by FirstMark and a who’s who of angels
stories.description: Daytona is building a cloud for agents that's like giving every agent its own computer. It has attracted founders of Stripe, Perplextity, Datadog, Mercor, and others as angels, it says.

stories.title: Rosebank: Life on the oil field at the centre of a political storm
stories.description: Scotland editor James Cook finds out what life is like on board a ship in an untapped oil field awaiting its fate.

stories.title: Heating oil costs 'more than double' ahead of winter
stories.description: Middleton in Teesdale has no mains gas supply so many residents use expensive heating oil.

stories.title: Cambridge scientists create a $10 chip that could put a medical lab on your wrist
stories.description: Cambridge researchers have created a groundbreaking $10 optical sensor that delivers the precision of laboratory equipment in a device small enough for wearable technology.

stories.title: Millions take fish oil for brain health. A two-year study found no benefit
stories.description: A surprising two-year clinical trial found that fish oil supplements successfully delivered omega-3s to the brain but failed to improve memory or protect against Alzheimer's-related brain shrinkage. Researchers suspect that getting these nutrients through a healthy diet may offer benefits that supplements alone cannot provide.

stories.title: ‘When it is your turn, open the door for the woman coming next’
stories.description: This week, Women in Solar+ Europe gives voice to Italian independent renewable energy consultant Giulia Muia. She says a resilient energy sector depends not only on diversified energy sources but also on diverse voices, perspectives, and inclusive leadership that drive innovation and better decisions.

stories.title: Birds are more afraid of women than men. Scientists have no idea why
stories.description: Scientists have uncovered a strange pattern in urban bird behavior: Across five European countries and 37 species, birds consistently fled sooner when approached by women than men. Researchers have no clear explanation for the difference, raising intriguing questions about how birds recognize and respond to humans.
